title: yummy hangover canadian chicken tacos
description: a peppery, cheese-pull hangover cure featuring chicken and ice-bath-shock, served in a molcajete.
instructions: season chicken breast with smoked paprika and black pepper
heat cooking oil in a pan over medium-high heat
add chicken to the pan and cook until browned on both sides
transfer chicken to a plate and set aside
crack eggs into the pan and scramble them
add canned tomatoes to the pan and stir
place chicken back in the pan and stir to coat with egg and tomato mixture
transfer mixture to molcajete and top with shredded cheese
place molcajete under the broiler until cheese is melted and bubbly
remove molcajete from the oven and let it cool for a minute
shock the molcajete in an ice bath for 30 seconds
remove molcajete from the ice bath and serve
